verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents built-in RAG: you can attach documents to chats and ask a local model questions about them entirely offline, with any supported model (docs-7, docs-23, docs-24). A community user also mentions its RAG plugin (comm-4), and the Bionic agent can create and edit documents with you (docs-15). missing for 10: proactive or automatically surfaced insights and suggestions (the RAG flow is user-prompted Q&A only), hands-on corroboration of RAG answer quality, and insights over data sources beyond attached documents.
